goals: Verify the root route (/) returns specific JSON content and a 200 status code.
Verify the /test route correctly processes POSTed data and allows its retrieval via GET.
activities: Initialize a test request for the application.
Send a GET request to the "/" endpoint.
Expect the response Content-Type header to be JSON.
Expect the response body to be { name: "frodo" }.
Expect the response status code to be 200.
Initialize a test request for the application.
Send a POST request to the "/test" endpoint.
Send the data { item: "hey" } in the request body.
Initialize another test request for the application.
Send a GET request to the "/test" endpoint.
Expect the response body to be { array: ["hey"] }.
